basic_details.job_title: DHS Goa Biochemist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Public Health Department (Directorate of Health Services) is hiring for 2 Biochemist posts at Pay Matrix Level 6, under Advertisement 10 Year 2026. One post is for General and one is for OBC (Non Creamy layer). You need an M.Sc in Biochemistry and knowledge of Konkani, and the maximum age is 45. Applications are open on the CBES portal (cbes.goa.gov.in) from 9 October 2026 to 23 October 2026.

how_to_apply: The advertisement is published on the CBES portal (cbes.goa.gov.in), which has Register and Login links for candidates. Applications are accepted from 9 October 2026 to 23 October 2026. The notice does not list any other application steps.

faq.question: Q1. How many Biochemist vacancies are there in DHS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Biochemist vacancies: 1 for General and 1 for OBC (Non Creamy layer).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 23 October 2026. Applications opened on 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: You need an M.Sc in Biochemistry as a principal subject of a recognised University and knowledge of Konkani.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as "MaxAge: 45".

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: The Biochemist post is paid as per pay matrix level 6.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: Apply online through the CBES portal (cbes.goa.gov.in), which has Register and Login links for candidates, between 9 October 2026 and 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is knowledge of Konkani compulsory for the Biochemist post?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is an essential qualification, while knowledge of Marathi is only desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Is experience required for the DHS Goa Biochemist post?
faq.answer: No, experience is not essential. Experience in the Bio-Chemical work in Bio-Chemistry Department of a recognised Institution is listed as desirable.
